records.rationale: Requirement identity and immutable provenance are governance-resolved, but the authorized historical carrier evidence contains no authoritative requirement-id-to-semantic-unit crosswalk. The 18,639 historical rows bind semantic_unit_id to schema_v2_property_path only. The historical 17 requirement records are index-only placeholders with null requirement text and UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_BINDING, so they cannot be semantically equated to the governance-bound requirement identifiers. No exact/composite carrier witness and no exhaustive requirement-specific negative domain is therefore proven without new semantic evidence.
